2609.35581.title: QC-Stark: A Multi-Task Benchmark Revealing Capability Dissociations in LLMs Evaluated on Quantum Computing Tasks
2609.35581.paper_summary: We introduce QC-Stark, a benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on 11 quantum computing (QC) tasks, spanning circuit construction, debugging, compilation, error correction, and simulation. Across 2,750 evaluations (10 models $\times$ 11 tasks x 5 difficulty levels x 5 seeds), we find that overall rankings mask substantial per-task variation. The Spearman correlation between overall and per-task rankings is statistically insignificant for 4 out of the 11 tasks included in this benchmark. A 2-parameter Item Response Theory (IRT) model validates measurement quality, and prompt sensitivity analysis confirms ranking robustness across prompt conditions. All tasks are auto-verifiable via execution, thus not requiring any manual evaluation. We make the code and data publicly available on Huggingface.
2609.35581.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 QC-Stark，這是一個用於評估大型語言模型（LLMs）在 11 個量子計算（QC）任務上的基準，涵蓋電路構建、除錯、編譯、錯誤修正和模擬。<lb/>在 2,750 次評估中（10 個模型 $\times$ 11 個任務 x 5 個難度級別 x 5 個隨機種子），我們發現整體排名掩蓋了每個任務的顯著變化。<lb/>在這個基準中，整體排名和每個任務排名之間的斯皮爾曼相關性對於 11 個任務中的 4 個是統計上不顯著的。<lb/>一個 2 參數的項目反應理論（IRT）模型驗證了測量質量，而提示敏感性分析則確認了在提示條件下排名的穩健性。<lb/>所有任務都可以通過執行自動驗證，因此不需要任何手動評估。<lb/>我們將代碼和數據公開提供在 Huggingface 上。
